commit.message:
AvatarManz: removed by GitHub for a Terms of Service violation, like Belobug (owner's report)

The owner reports AvatarManz went the same way as Belobug: GitHub suspended
the repository and account for a Terms of Service violation. The card's nuke
note, byline, summary and blocker, the change log and EDITOR.md now say so
instead of "cause unknown". Card stays nuked with its progress kept (81.8%).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Known issues: outdoor flicker, dark rooms without `-RayTracing`, late textures, first-run pipeline stutter. These are in `blockers`.
   - **Proof link:** the owner's video on r/FitGirlRepack (`reddit.com/r/FitGirlRepack/comments/1y5k8xu/actually_playable/`), a piracy-repack subreddit, the same place as Belobug's proof. Nobody here could read the post (Reddit is blocked for our tools), and the owner chose to link it anyway. Remove the link if the post turns out to carry a download; never link a download from it.
   - Keep the values; don't lower them or remove the entry on your own. Recheck `play.ps1` and look for releases or download links if they appear.
-  - **Offline, nuked card (2026-11-27, owner's report):** at 18:39 UTC both `avatarmanz/VIctory-7900XTX` and the `avatarmanz` GitHub account answered 404, hours after Belobug's. The owner doesn't know whether it was a DMCA notice, a Terms of Service removal or the owner taking it private, so the site says only that it went offline and the cause isn't known. Same treatment as Belobug: `repo: null`, `nuked` with `show: true` and `keepScore: true` (greyed card at the bottom of the race, unranked, progress still in the headline), `basedOn` victory-fork, DexNom, VIctory and Belobug, `related` with the old repo name for the copy filter, `stats: {}`, ratings unchanged (81.8%). DexNom is #2 in the race. Report the cause if it becomes known, or the repo coming back.
+  - **Offline, nuked card (2026-11-27, owner's report):** at 18:39 UTC both `avatarmanz/VIctory-7900XTX` and the `avatarmanz` GitHub account answered 404, hours after Belobug's. The owner first didn't know whether it was a DMCA notice, a Terms of Service removal or the owner taking it private, then reported that it was the same as Belobug: GitHub suspended it for a Terms of Service violation. The site says GitHub removed it for violating its Terms of Service, confirmed by PortWatch; don't call it a DMCA takedown. Same treatment as Belobug: `repo: null`, `nuked` with `show: true` and `keepScore: true` (greyed card at the bottom of the race, unranked, progress still in the headline), `basedOn` victory-fork, DexNom, VIctory and Belobug, `related` with the old repo name for the copy filter, `stats: {}`, ratings unchanged (81.8%). DexNom is #2 in the race. Report the cause if it becomes known, or the repo coming back.
 - **NotNozy (2026-11-25, owner's call):** a private build streamed on Rumble, `rumble.com/v7iv98i-gta6-modding-stream.html` ("GTA6 Modding Stream", channel NotNozy, page time 2026-11-24 21:30 UTC, shown live on the 25th, no links in its description). The owner says it looks about the same as AvatarManz's and wants it about 0.5 behind. Following DexNom's precedent, it has AvatarManz's values with `render: 0.76` instead of 0.8 (same "Close to the console" step): `story: 0.5`, `fps: 16`, `stability: 0.9`, 82.6%, second overall. Nobody measured its frame rate or crash record; the card's "16 FPS" and "Stable" follow AvatarManz, and a blocker says so. AMD card: the owner first said NVIDIA, then corrected it to AMD, so `gpu: ["AMD"]`. Base unknown (`basedOn: []`), evidence "Rumble stream", the stream as its `proof` link, no avatar, `verification: "self-reported"`. Keep the values; report a measured frame rate, the PC, or code going public.
 - **Doomsday (2026-11-25, owner's call):** a private group, verified by PortWatch, on `JoshuuDev/victory-amd` (a GitHub fork of `myokex/victory-amd`, not tracked, so `basedOn` is empty and the byline names it). The owner says it has ray-traced lighting at 3-5 fps, almost no crashes and the same story progress as Belobug and DexNom, with rendering a bit behind DexNom's; the phone renders well and the map menu runs faster. Mostly AMD, also works on NVIDIA at lower fps. Values: `story: 0.5`, `render: 0.85`, `fps: 4`, `stability: 0.8` (ZETTROX's value for "almost never crashes"): 78.7%. It leads the headline; DexNom stays #1 in the race. The card links the group's X, `x.com/Stu9ao`, as a `proof` link (private cards show `proof` since this change). The avatar `assets/img/efforts/doomsday.jpg` is the owner's picture, cropped. Keep the values; don't lower them or remove the entry on your own. Its Setup.cmd only builds from source with cargo and adds a Start-menu shortcut; Initialize-FormatTables.ps1 downloads one data file from Marvisak/VIctory at a pinned commit and checks its SHA-256 (read on 2026-11-25). Recheck both scripts if they change, and never link a prebuilt download from it. Keep the values; don't lower them or remove the entry on your own.
 - **A shorter board (2026-11-25, owner's call):** the race now holds only public builds scored at or above XCL (35% that day: Belobug, ZETTROX, hyphennn, Uilian, VIctory, XCL). Everything below XCL went to the watchlist: Xbox2Windows, TuxBox, xbox-emulator, ScarlettX, OpenScarlett (Community Edition), OpenScarlett, scarlett-layer, XValkyrie, AnyXboxX. Keep that rule: a project joins the race only when it passes XCL, and one that falls behind XCL moves to the watchlist. The watchlist and the toolkit start collapsed. The "New candidates" and "Fake downloads" sections are gone from the site; `candidates` and `flagged` stay in tracker.json for your review. Nuked entries (Leonida, americas-recomp) are no longer shown anywhere, but keep them in `efforts`: their repo names stop the scout listing their copies as candidates.
